title: CoreRefundCommandV2
description: Core-v1.2 refund command payload (docs/core-contracts.md sections 1, 2 and 5).

Version marker: the URN and the envelope's schema_version=2 identify this protocol. The command carries no schema_version of its own, because every field it does carry is covered by payload_hash - a field outside the hash would let two different commands share a digest.

Deliberately absent, unlike the v1 compat command: entitlement_id (v1 filled it in after reservation, so the hash depended on a field that did not exist when the payload was fixed), address_hash (the v1 reship branch), and action RESHIP (docs/core-scope.md defers reship; the v1 Action enum keeps it as a compat asset only).
The required property set must equal canonical.REFUND_FIELDS plus payload_hash; test_contracts_core_schemas.py asserts that equality so this schema and the hasher cannot drift apart.

operation_id.description: Pre-allocated when the authorisation is created and fixed for the whole operation (docs/core-contracts.md:19).

authorization_id.description: Correlation only: the consumer must still verify signature, payload_hash and audience (docs/contracts.md:130).

input_revision.description: Decision-input revision, not an optimistic-lock version (docs/domain-model.md:3).

action.description: The only executable core action; a reship command is not representable in v2.

quantity.description: Whole-line refund only: this is the line's full quantity (docs/core-scope.md:9).

amount_minor.description: Integer minor units; the original line's paid amount. Float money is refused by the schema and by the canonicaliser (docs/contracts.md:19).

payload_hash.description: SHA-256 over the canonical JSON of the other twelve fields. Excludes itself, trace and send time.
